summary: Adjudicate tcodex's five never-reviewed dLLM proposals (N1-N5) with firability prechecks and diverse-lens refutation

per_proposal.reason: Gate CANNOT FIRE, and it is the P1-c1 defect in a subtler costume. I built the exact null 'conversion changed NOTHING about suffix use' (Dream carries Qwen's identical log-odds suffix effect, merely uniformly weaker) and it predicts Delta_surface = +10.4902 pp -- ABOVE the 5.0 pp kill line and 0.23 pp above the observed +10.2614. The zero-effect value of the statistic already clears its own threshold; the gate fires only if Dream retains <77.7% of Qwen's log-odds suffix effect, and the observed ratio is 0.9891. I reproduced all four cells from the on-disk maps (.935140/.660213/.879961/.502420, n=1033, identical task_id sets asserted). Scale-free re-expressions of the SAME four cells: log-odds DiD -0.02184, headroom-recovered -5.9900 pp (SIGN FLIP). Regrouping by model kills the narrative: D_FIM-Q_FIM = -5.52 pp, D_prefix-Q_prefix = -15.78 pp -- Qwen wins BOTH cells, so the entire +10.26 pp is Dream being less-bad in the FIM cell. SECOND independent kill, verified by me from DreamOn's camera-ready (arXiv:2602.01326, ICLR 2026 Poster, venueid ICLR.cc/2026/Conference, forum EQTPmqukiU, Camera_Ready_Revision present -- RETRIEVED this pass): substituting its published Table 2 Dream-Coder-7B row into N1's own DiD gives -52.8/-16.5/-5.1/-15.3/-22.2 pp at initial_masks 4/8/16/32/64 and +15.6 pp at oracle -- the gate FIRES at every non-oracle canvas DreamOn validated and survives only at oracle. The swing is 47.7 pp = 9.54x N1's entire threshold, and 32 is not even the published optimum (16 is). I also computed forward_passes_per_task = 8.5789 for both pilot Dream arms, so the +10.26 pp was NOT produced at initial_masks=32. THIRD: N1 is an undisclosed re-proposal of B10 kill_gate.gate_2 ('lineage repair on Dream-Coder-v0-Base-7B', gpu '~2-4 GPU-h' -- N1's arms and N1's cost), which STATUS.json records as NOT authorised because gate_1 FIRED (exact McNemar p=1.0000, b=39 c=38); next_gate reads 'REWRITE AS A PROTOCOL NOTE, OR ARCHIVE IT. 0 GPU'. N1's headline is also the repo's already-SEALED survivor with the seal reversed (PROTOCOL_NOTE.md:90-96 states it 'must not be read as diffusion benefits more from bidirectionality'). NOT preempted -- I overrule any preemption reading: DiffuLLaMA (verified ICLR 2025 Poster, venueid ICLR.cc/2025/Conference, forum j1tSLYKwg8, Camera_Ready present; full text RETRIEVED, states verbatim 'humaneval-single-line infilling ... contains 1033 test cases' and the oracle-length device, plus a Table 8 matched-lineage control 0.80/0.74/0.76) reports cell means, never a paired item-level decomposition. N1 dies on its own gate, a licensed kill route, not on prior art.
per_proposal.gate_fires: NO -- all three clauses miss by wide margins; clause 1's zero-effect null (+10.49 pp) already passes its own 5.0 pp bar; clause 2 (bootstrap CI excludes zero by 7.15 pp) adds zero independent kill power; clause 3 (81.76% vs a 70% bar) is direction-arbitrary -- the mirror direction 242/411 = 58.9% FIRES on the same numerator. Threshold was also set after the value was known: field 3 quotes the measured 27.49/37.75/81.8% and field 4 then places the kill line at 5.0 pp, exactly the bottom edge of the author's own predicted 5-8 pp landing zone. Both named confound repairs push the statistic AWAY from firing.
per_proposal.narrowed_form_if_any: SURVIVES NARROWED at 0 GPU as a reporting-standards paragraph, NOT a proposal and NOT a GPU experiment: 'A canvas-frozen pp-scale DiD does not identify suffix-utilisation transfer.' Four legs, all already payable on wzc1: (1) report the scale-free statistic (log-odds DiD -0.0218) as a NEGATIVE result, not a gate to be passed; (2) make canvas an axis and pre-register against DreamOn's published 4-64 curve (the remedy AUDIT_VERDICT imposed on P4); (3) fix the comparator set -- replace Dream-Coder/Repr-Align/OPDLM (which have ~0 occurrences of FIM/suffix) with DiffuLLaMA (ICLR 2025) + InCoder + FIM, stating the delta against each; (4) replace the retention clause, which fails its own reversal test (242/296 = .8176 passes but 242/411 = .5888 fires), with retention minus Dream's own independence null. Must carry the PROTOCOL_NOTE.md 2.1 seal. Barred: N1's licensed sentence 'AR->diffusion conversion changed how a matched lineage exploits visible right context' -- today's scale-free data supports the OPPOSITE.

per_proposal.reason: Gate is UNDEFINED, not underpowered, and the estimand dissolves before the gate is even reached. DECISIVE, and I reproduced it exactly: the target quantity is 95.7% a THIRD mechanism the two-way space/compute partition has no cell for. From evidence/cells/he_c{32,128}.json, empty_raw_output is 75/164 at c32 and 0/164 at c128. Decomposing pass@1 = P(nonempty) x P(pass|nonempty): total +22.5600 pp = OCCUPANCY +21.5815 pp (95.7%) + CONDITIONAL +0.9785 pp (4.3%), sum reproducing exactly; the conditional rate barely moves (.471915 -> .481700). The conditional term is 11.5x SMALLER than the gate's own 11.28 pp threshold, so a positive result would mean 'canvas 128 stops the model deleting its entire canvas', not 'space beats compute'. Replicated on a second benchmark: MBPP+ c8->c32 occupancy is 123.4% of the gap with the conditional term NEGATIVE (-6.20 pp). SECOND: the treatment is arithmetically impossible on the majority of the sample. From generation_utils.py (on disk, RETRIEVED): line 435 topk with number_transfer_tokens=1 resolves exactly one mask per counted forward, lines 383-384 set expand_budget = 2*max_gen_len, giving NFE = canvas + 2E. Verified against disk: nfe_median == canvas EXACTLY in 5/5 cells (8.0/32.0/128.0/8.0/32.0) and max-canvas = 2052 in 5/5 (max 2060/2084/2180). With n=164 even and floor 32, >=83/164 = 50.61% of items have max_nfe_i = 32, so a 32-forward cap on a 128-mask canvas leaves >=75% of masks unresolved -- and silently, since mask 151666 is in all_special_ids and the driver decodes with skip_special_tokens=True. THIRD: the named mediator is identically zero -- word-boundary counts in generation_utils.py are remask=0, unmask=0, revision=0, refine=0, and line 442 writes only where line 403's mask selector holds, so a settled content token is never revisited. DreamOn has no revision channel; 'refinement compute' is a category error (the P6 defect). FOURTH: closed at 0 GPU by its own target paper -- DreamOn 5.3/5.4, RETRIEVED verbatim by me: 'Disabling deletion broadcasting reduces performance by 0.6% on average' and 'accelerates generation by 2.1x' (steps 122.8 -> 52.4). I re-derived the Table 3 row: 90.8 vs 90.2 = 0.6 pp. So the published same-model FIXED-CANVAS elasticity is 2.1x forwards <-> 0.6 pp, while N2's gate demands a 1.5073x NFE change explain >=11.28 pp -- an 18.8x larger response to a 1.39x smaller change. That is the P5 defect. FIFTH: the cap vector exists on no disk reachable from LOCAL (all 5 cells record run_dir=/apdcephfs_zwfy6; I re-confirmed 'No such file or directory' with df showing only dop-fuse on wzc1), and mbpp_c128 was never graded, so the grid is HE+ only, 5 cells not 6. Cost unit already adjudicated wrong: NFE 1.5073x vs tokens_fed 1.9334x leaves 22.0% of attended-work growth unmatched.
per_proposal.gate_fires: UNDEFINED -- not underpowered. The named treatment (per-item cap at the observed c32 NFE) cannot be delivered to >=50.6% of the sample by arithmetic; the cap vector is on no reachable disk so the arm cannot even be configured; the mediator it names is identically 0 in the target's sampler; and the gate's own named branch (quota-finish) is the confound at maximum, requiring 4.0 masks/forward vs a baseline of 1. Every artefact pushes toward NOT firing, i.e. toward N2's own claim surviving.
per_proposal.narrowed_form_if_any: SURVIVES NARROWED at 0 GPU, and unusually it has a gate that genuinely fires both ways: 'The apparent initial-canvas effect on EvalPlus pass@1 is dominated by an OCCUPANCY channel -- the fraction of items for which the sampler deletes its entire canvas and emits nothing -- rather than by any change in code quality conditional on something being emitted.' PRE-REGISTER: KILL if occupancy is not the majority contributor in >=5 of the 6 available (benchmark x grader x canvas-step) cells, OR if the conditional-term 95% CI excludes zero in the HE+ c32->c128 corrected cell. Both branches were attainable before looking; measured, occupancy dominates 6/6 and the conditional CI contains zero, so it does not fire. Two paragraphs plus one table inside an existing document. MUST NOT be framed as a canvas finding (DAEDAL + rho-EOS own that), must not use the banned 'cost of canvas' / 'quality is bought with canvas' framings, and must drop 'refinement compute' / 'remasking count' entirely. DEAD and not to be revived: the space-vs-compute partition (unidentifiable, since 48.1% of the c32->c128 compute increase IS the canvas at 1 forward/slot), the per-item NFE cap, and the 11.3 pp threshold.

per_proposal.reason: Gate fires against itself, but the deeper and more valuable finding is that the statistic CANNOT CLEAR ITS OWN NOISE FLOOR, which is sitting on disk. I reproduced this exactly: there are THREE H20 observations of the identical thing, and they disagree by 2x. Same node .73, same torch 2.5.1+cu124 / transformers 4.46.2, same 48 task_ids, same driver, constant 512 NFE per item, and CROSSNODE_REPRODUCIBILITY.md:169 declares the pair verbatim 'F vs C (H20, both torch 2.5.1) | what varies: nothing'. Measured: C = 51.784 s vs F = 106.064 s, ratio 2.0482 (mean) / 2.0315 (median) / 2.0485 (geomean per-item), F>C on 48/48 items, per-item ratio range [2.009, 2.110] -- a uniform level shift, not a tail. In the gate's own units ln(2.0482) = 0.7170 vs threshold |ln 0.80| = 0.2231, so single-leg replicate noise is 3.21x the entire detectable effect. The noise is also asymmetric: the sm_100 side has 4 replicates (A 11.415 / A2 11.279 / B 11.851 / B2 11.812 s, paired n=164) = 1.0507x spread, so H20 carries 14.5x more log-noise. The cross-hardware ratio the gate consumes is therefore 6.173x / 8.003x / 9.086x purely by replicate choice (implied kill bars 4.938 / 6.402 / 7.269). Mechanism verified and NOT thermal: Pearson(position-in-rank-stream, elapsed) = -0.5689 on C (first-half 84.73 -> last-half 53.94 s) vs -0.0239 on A (ratio 1.011) -- a decaying co-tenant. SECOND: the precondition is destroyed by the effect under study. Clause 2 demands the arms sit within 1 pp; on n=164 one item = 0.60976 pp; but hardware ALONE moves Dream's own HE+ pass@1 from 116/164 = .707317 (sm_100) to 112/164 = .682927 (H20) = 4 items = 2.4390 pp = 2.44x the tolerance, with identical weights and one grader. THIRD: N3's stated delta is factually FALSE. I retrieved arXiv:2510.18480's full text and scanned for A6000|A100|H100|H200|B200|H800|A800|V100|RTX|MI300 -- exactly ONE hardware token, 'A800', in 'All experiments are conducted on a single NVIDIA A800 GPU (80 GB) using FP16 precision.' N3 claims it profiles 'A6000/A100/H100-class systems'. FOURTH: 2 of the 4 gate cells have no code path (neither generator takes a batch argument), so the 'geometric mean across four cells' is over 2. CORRECTIONS I make to the precheck: (a) it fired clause 2 on the WRONG AXIS -- _run_nfe_sweep_wzc1.sh line 4 varies --steps and line 25 pins --max-new-tokens 512 (repo-wide: 35x 512, none at 64), so no output-budget ladder exists on disk; (b) it claimed no latency-vs-software control exists and the axis is 'physically un-freezable' -- E vs F on fixed H20 gives E/F = 0.8807 (11.9%), which indicts N3 further since the NULL C-vs-F is 5.1x larger than the measured software effect; (c) its roofline argument is invalid, since SM count and memory capacity are not roofline parameters.
per_proposal.gate_fires: FIRES AGAINST ITSELF -- clause 2 (matched quality within 1 pp) is unsatisfiable because hardware alone moves the same config 2.4390 pp = 2.44x the tolerance, and clause 1's denominator (Qwen-on-H20 latency) has n=0 on any reachable disk so it is UNDEFINED as posed. Worse than firing: the statistic cannot clear a 2.05x measured within-condition noise floor with a 1.25x threshold.
per_proposal.narrowed_form_if_any: SURVIVES NARROWED and this is the batch's BEST residue -- but as a latency-REPRODUCIBILITY claim, not a hardware-crossover one: 'For a fully pinned mask-diffusion decoding protocol, the within-condition replicate spread of end-to-end latency on a shared H20 node is >=2x -- larger than the cross-architecture effects dLLM efficiency papers report to two significant figures. Single-run latency numbers in dLLM efficiency papers are therefore not falsifiable claims.' ~80% already measured from 4 on-disk metrics.jsonl. Mandatory changes: drop matched-quality entirely; drop the AR comparator (different training regime, +39/+40 token template gap, and an early-stop path the dLLM lacks -- 119/164 vs 0/164); freeze BOTH legs at torch 2.11 (unobstructed, since only sm_100-cannot-run-2.5.1 forbids freezing at the OLD stack); require n>=3 temporally interleaved replicates with exclusive tenancy asserted per replicate. FIRABLE GATE: KILL if, with n>=3 interleaved exclusive-tenancy replicates per cell, the max/min within-cell latency ratio is <1.20 on BOTH hardware types -- genuinely two-sided (currently would NOT fire on H20 at 2.0482x but WOULD on sm_100 at 1.0507x). Five binding guards: no cross-family Dream/Qwen number (the AR harness carries a per-forward device->host .item() sync the Dream harness does not); no claim hardware causes the gap; no canvas/NFE-cost framing; no batch-size axis; report the 2.05x as 'unexplained, provenance-incomplete' -- do NOT assert a cause.

per_proposal.reason: Gate fires against itself at 0 GPU, from a file the authors ship. The 'foreign vanilla sampler' arm N4 proposes to run is a PUBLISHED COLUMN: I read tad_gh/eval_llada.sh and found four blocks each headed '# TAD-LLaDA-TPF1' invoking threshold=0 with no multi_block, on gsm8k/math/humaneval/mbpp. I verified threshold=0 degenerates to one-token-per-forward: eval_llada.py:75 tests 'if entropy_threshold is not None' (true for 0), Shannon entropy at line 67 is >=0 so line 76's '< 0' selects nothing, and the argmin fallback at 77-80 unmasks exactly one position => TPF 1.000. From TAD's own data_llada.yaml (baseline LLaDA 38.28 HE / 41.72 MBPP), retention = vanilla_gain/official_gain is 371.1% (HE TAD-S), 148.3% (HE TAD-Q), -150.0% and -900.0% (MBPP). The gate KILLs at >50%, so it FIRES on both HE cells; and retention exceeds 100% everywhere it is defined -- the distilled checkpoint scores HIGHER under the FOREIGN schedule (43.29 vs 39.63; 43.90 vs 42.07; 43.40 vs 40.60; 42.80 vs 41.60). The official schedule COSTS accuracy and buys parallelism, the opposite of the claim. MBPP denominators are -1.12 and -0.12 pp = 5.6 and 0.6 items on n=500: the unguarded near-zero denominator that is the P2 defect. SECOND: '8-step' is not expressible under the official sampler. I re-derived rather than carrying -- generate_multi_block spans eval_llada.py:328-424 and get_num_transfer_tokens is called only at 139/199/278, all in the NON-multi_block paths, so steps is dead in the official branch. And at TAD's gen_length=256, N4's NFE {8,32,128} maps to TPF {32.0, 8.0, 2.0} while TAD's largest measured TPF anywhere in its own yaml is 9.11 (largest TAD row 8.47) -- N4's HEADLINE cell sits 3.78x beyond the furthest point the target paper ever measured (the P4 out-of-validated-range defect). THIRD: the two 'samplers' are two points on a compute axis -- from the yaml's own rho, the official arm runs at implied NFE = 256/rho = 41.9-75.7 while the vanilla arm runs at 256, so the two gains are measured 3.38x-6.11x apart in compute, and any interaction is a budget effect with a sampler label. FOURTH: benchmark identity -- grep -ci over TAD's full text for evalplus|humaneval\+|mbpp\+|sanitized = 0; TAD evaluates original HumanEval/MBPP via lm-evaluation-harness, so the retention denominator has no published referent on HE+/MBPP+. NOT preempted (d3LLM and CaRE do not run one release's bespoke schedule on another's weights, and CaRE at 2.4 months is concurrent) -- it dies on its own gate. Cost is also understated: 6-10 claimed vs ~12-46 GPU-h by the A05 anchor, plus 32.1 GB of downloads.
per_proposal.gate_fires: FIRES AGAINST ITSELF at 0 GPU -- retention is 371.1% / 148.3% against a 'KILL if >50%' clause, computed from the target's own released leaderboard file; and on MBPP the official gains are NEGATIVE (-1.12, -0.12 pp = 5.6 and 0.6 items) so 'fraction retained' is ill-posed there. The conjunct also needs the LLaDA x official cell, which is published in neither the paper nor the yaml, so the conjunction is arguably not evaluable at all.
per_proposal.narrowed_form_if_any: NONE as an experiment. Do not queue the 6-10 GPU-h (true cost ~12-46) and do not download the 32.1 GB. The only survivor is a one-sentence reporting note: in one released repo the selector string 'low_confidence' names two different statistics -- the eval path (eval_llada.py:66-67, Shannon entropy, topk(largest=False)) vs the generation path (generate.py:107,121, max-probability, topk(largest=True)) -- so papers reporting a swap to 'the vanilla confidence sampler' should say which statistic they used. Note the two lenses DISAGREE on the magnitude (5/40 rank agreement on flat synthetic logits vs 99.0% top-1 agreement on peaked realistic logits); the second is the better-evidenced regime, so the honest framing is 'the string is overloaded', NOT 'the samplers disagree'. A second lead -- that AUP is approximately affine in the author-chosen sweep endpoint, with 24/24 commented-out points on competitor arms and 0 on TAD's own (inputs verified by me on disk) -- is worth a separate 0-GPU verification pass, but its claimed rank flips are CARRIED, not verified, and must not be published without an independent re-run and author contact.

per_proposal.reason: Gate fires against itself at 0 GPU, on TWO independent published replications, and this is the cleanest kill in the batch. DAEDAL (ICLR 2026 Poster, venueid ICLR.cc/2026/Conference) runs BOTH of N5's checkpoints at SIX matched canvases with N5's own length metric, using verbatim (line 500, RETRIEVED by me) 'the official generation code released with LLaDA, without any acceleration or caching optimizations ... 8 NVIDIA A800 80G GPUs, with the batch size set to 8', printing E_token = 'the net response length after removing trailing EOS padding'. rho-EOS (arXiv:2601.22527, CoRR 2026) replicates the identical grid and states 'each experiment is repeated three times, and we report the averaged results'. I computed Delta = LLaDA-1.5 minus Instruct on HumanEval from both primary texts: DAEDAL -0.6/-4.2/+1.8/-1.9/+1.8/+3.0 and rho-EOS +0.5/-5.5/+1.8/+0.0/+4.3/+0.6 at canvas 64/128/256/512/1024/2048. Clause 1 (KILL if raw gain <2 pp) fires 5/6 in each, and critically 4/4 at N5's two pre-registered canvases {128,512}. The length mediator is ALREADY equalised there: DAEDAL E_token 125 vs 125 (c128) and 471 vs 475 (c512); rho-EOS 125 vs 124.9 and 462 vs 473.8. At matched output length LLaDA-1.5 is WORSE on HumanEval, so there is no positive gain for a length mediator to explain and clause 2's '% of gain removed' divides by a negative number (the P3 defect). SECOND: the mediator has near-zero between-arm variance where N5 measures and N5 does not look where it moves -- mean |dE_token| is 2.0 tok at {128,512} vs 60.5 tok at {1024,2048}, and those are the only canvases with a positive gain; the implied dose-response flips sign and spans three orders of magnitude (-32.8 pp/token at c128, -0.41 at c512, +0.05 at c1024). THIRD, correcting the precheck: it reports clause 2's AND-conjunct as SATISFIED (+2.3 pp interaction) but that holds on DAEDAL only -- on rho-EOS the same interaction is +5.50 pp (Instruct +18.9, LLaDA-1.5 +24.4), NOT satisfied. The 3 pp threshold sits BETWEEN two equally matched published measurements whose spread (3.2 pp) exceeds the threshold itself. FOURTH: the EOS convention is circular -- VRPO states verbatim 'setting the |EOS| token's confidence score to zero improved HumanEval scores from 47.6 to 49.4. Consequently, we adopted this setting for evaluation', so 1.8 pp of N5's own denominator is a knob setting and that knob IS the termination policy N5 wants to measure. FIFTH: N5's stated matched-sampler cell is the negative one -- VRPO Table 4 low-confidence remasking (N5's stipulated 'confidence sampler') gives 49.4 -> 47.0 = -2.4 pp.
per_proposal.gate_fires: FIRES AGAINST ITSELF at 0 GPU -- clause 1 fires 4/4 at N5's own pre-registered canvases in two independent published replications, and 10/12 across both full six-canvas grids. Clause 2 is then undefined because its denominator (the raw gain) is negative or zero at those canvases, and its AND-conjunct is lab-dependent (+2.3 pp DAEDAL vs +5.50 pp rho-EOS against a 3 pp threshold).
per_proposal.narrowed_form_if_any: NONE as an experiment -- no narrowing of this checkpoint pair on HumanEval can produce the positive gain the claim requires. What survives is a 0-GPU caveat paragraph, composable with the N3 residue: three papers report LLaDA-8B-Instruct HumanEval at generation length 512 as 49.4 (VRPO Tbl4) / 47.0 (DAEDAL Tbl1) / 45.1 (rho-EOS Tbl1, 3-run averaged) -- a 4.3 pp spread on ONE frozen (checkpoint, benchmark, length) cell, with a 2.5 pp maximum and 0.983 pp mean disagreement across the 12 shared cells of the two full replications. Both exceed N5's own 2.0 pp decision threshold. Must be written as a reproducibility caveat naming all three sources, must not be inflated into a proposal, and must not claim canvas sensitivity as a finding. Also banked: a VENUE CORRECTION -- VRPO/LLaDA-1.5 is ACL 2026 Long, pages 11425-11460 (2026.acl-long.524, doi 10.18653/v1/2026.acl-long.524, bibkey zhu-etal-2026-llada), NOT a preprint; CLAUDE_FRONTIER_20260815.md:97 and the precheck are both wrong, and OpenReview shows only CoRR 2025 plus an ICLR 2026 Withdrawn_Submission -- a textbook instance of both repo fallacies.

verdict.survivors: 0 of 5 as dispatchable proposals. All five refuted 3/3 by lenses with independent attack surfaces; all five died on gate construction (N1 gate cannot fire; N2 UNDEFINED; N3/N4/N5 fire against themselves). Three of the five (N1 partially, N4, N5) were decided AGAINST the proposal by data the proposal itself cites -- TAD's own launch script, DreamOn's own Table 2/Table 3, and two independent published DAEDAL/rho-EOS replications. Three 0-GPU narrowed residues survive as reporting-standards notes, ranked in the file: N3-narrowed (latency irreproducibility, the only genuinely new non-preempted result), N2-narrowed (occupancy decomposition, gate verified firing 6/6), N1-narrowed (scale-free DiD, a negative result). N4 and N5 survive only as one-sentence caveats, not as directions.
verdict.the_one_to_run_first: NONE of N1-N5. Do not queue any of the 24-99 GPU-h they ask for. The single first action is the N3-NARROWED latency-irreproducibility note, and it needs ZERO GPU. First step: assemble it from four files already on wzc1 -- /apdcephfs_wzc1/share_304376610/pighzliu_code/dllm_draft/runs/xnode/{A_local_L20A_wzc1_t211, C_73_H20_zwfy6_t251, E_73_H20_t260_lim48, F_73_H20_t251_lim48}/metrics.jsonl plus their stack_meta.json. GPU NEEDED: no. MEASURED COST: 0 GPU-h, ~2 CPU-hours. Pre-registered gate that can fire both ways: KILL if, with n>=3 temporally interleaved exclusive-tenancy replicates per cell, the max/min within-cell latency ratio is <1.20 on BOTH hardware types -- currently would NOT fire on H20 (2.0482x) but WOULD on sm_100 (1.0507x). If a card frees later, the follow-up is ~2 extra H20 replicates x 164 items = ~6.4 GPU-h card-time (~0.8 h wall on 8 H20, anchored on arm C's measured 11,555.8 s = 3.21 GPU-h), but it MUST run on an idle exclusively-held node, because exclusive tenancy is the entire point -- running it on a shared node would reproduce the defect it measures.
zero_gpu_actions: RANK 1 -- Write the N3-narrowed latency-irreproducibility note (~2 CPU-h). Everything needed is on wzc1: C vs F = 2.0482x on 48/48 items under declared-identical conditions (3.21x the gate's own 20% threshold in log units); H20-only co-tenancy transient (Pearson -0.5689) absent on sm_100 (-0.0239); software axis on fixed hardware worth 11.9% (E/F = 0.8807) while worth 0 quality flips. RANK 2 -- File the N2-narrowed occupancy decomposition (~2 CPU-h). Adopt the 4-check STANDING RULE before any future gate is pre-registered (documented in section 7 of the verdict file): (1) NULL-VALUE check -- state the statistic's value under no-effect; if it already passes, the gate is void (would have killed N1 c1); (2) PUBLISHED-LEVER check -- for every hyperparameter frozen by fiat, quote the target paper's own sweep and the implied swing (would have killed N1, caught P4); (3) ALREADY-ANSWERED check -- grep the target paper's tables AND its released launch scripts for the arms you propose to run (would have killed N4 and N5, caught P5); (4) FLOOR check -- state the measured within-condition replicate spread; if the threshold is inside the floor, the gate cannot fire honestly (would have killed N3). Each costs minutes.
